The gray shaded part is L-shaped, located on the left side and bottom, surrounding part of the middle 3×3 square. method.method_draft: Decompose the shaded L-shape directly into two non-overlapping rectangles. From the image, read that the top-left small square has side 1, the central white square has side 3, and the bottom-right small square has side 1. The vertical shaded strip has width 1, matching the top-left 1-square, and height 3+1=4, spanning beside the central 3-square and the bottom 1-square. The horizontal shaded strip to its right has height 1, matching the bottom-right 1-square, and width 3, matching the central square. Add the two rectangle areas: 1·4 + 3·1 = 7.
